_comment: Single source of truth for the conformance hygiene linter. lint_config.py loads this; lint-rules.md is generated from it (scripts/gen_lint_docs.py). To add a data-only rule, edit 'lookups'. To add a new rule id, add it to 'rules' AND its detection in lint_config.py, then run gen_lint_docs.py and add a test.

docset-entitlement-mismatch.detection: A docSet whose idDocSetType needs an entitlement absent from the tenant's allowedChecks
docset-entitlement-mismatch.fix: Enable the entitlement (CSM) or drop the step. Unknown when entitlements could not be fetched.

device-intelligence-no-entitlement.detection: deviceIntelligenceSettings.enabled:true without DEVICE_INTELLIGENCE (a bare DEVICE_CHECK step is covered by docset-entitlement-mismatch)
device-intelligence-no-entitlement.fix: Enable DEVICE_INTELLIGENCE, then GET the level back to confirm it stuck — otherwise the API silently stores enabled:false.

aml-provider-invalid.detection: watchListCheckSettings.amlCaseType not in the valid provider set
aml-provider-invalid.fix: Use a valid provider or omit amlCaseType to inherit the tenant default.

aml-custom-watchlist-gated.fix: Confirm the tenant is provisioned, or set useCustomWatchListCheckSettings:false and omit amlCaseType.

poa-preset-missing.fix: Create a PoA preset and wire its id into poaStepSettingsId — the server rejects the level otherwise.

poa-preset-unresolved.detection: poaStepSettingsId points at an id that did not resolve
poa-preset-unresolved.fix: Point poaStepSettingsId at an existing PoA preset in this tenant.

questionnaire-missing.fix: Create a questionnaire and wire its id into questionnaireDefId.

questionnaire-unresolved.fix: Point questionnaireDefId at an existing questionnaire in this tenant.

selfie-no-liveness.fix: Set videoRequired (default passiveLiveness; photoRequired to skip liveness deliberately).

selfie-deprecated-liveness.detection: SELFIE videoRequired in the discouraged set
selfie-deprecated-liveness.fix: Use passiveLiveness (default), or photoRequired to intentionally skip liveness.

duplicate-docset-type.detection: Any idDocSetType appears more than once
duplicate-docset-type.fix: Keep one, or use the numbered variant (e.g. IDENTITY2) — a distinct type string.

poa-allowed-types-bad-keys.detection: PoA allowedTypesSettings keys outside the provider-category set
poa-allowed-types-bad-keys.fix: Keys must be provider categories, not document sub-types.

workflow-high-risk-no-pep-aml.detection: Workflow routes on country/risk but has no PEP/AML/watchlist branch (substring heuristic)
workflow-high-risk-no-pep-aml.fix: Confirm high-risk applicants get enhanced screening (PEP/AML) somewhere in the flow.
